title: nim-tune recommended config (final/recommended_config.json)
description: The tuned configuration nim-deploy reads with `nimdeploy.py new --from FILE`. nim-deploy validates it with the stdlib subset in scripts/handoff.py (type, const, enum, required, properties, additionalProperties, propertyNames, items, minLength, maxLength, minimum, pattern).

created_at.description: When the result was written, ISO 8601 with a time zone (2026-10-29T08:00:00Z)

model.description: The model as nim-select names it (meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct), not the served name

image.description: The image with its version tag, without a digest

image_digest.description: The digest of the image that was measured, when known

gpu_name.description: The GPU model it was measured on, as nvidia-smi names it (NVIDIA H100 NVL); null when the campaign did not record it (nim-deploy then asks before using the result)

args.description: Engine arguments, each option and value its own item; [] when the baseline won

env.description: Non-secret environment that was measured: the shared base env plus the winner's own env; for a baseline win the base env alone

env_from_host.description: Secret NAMES the config needs; never values

baseline_won.description: true: the untuned config won, so there is no tuned change (args is []; env is still the base env it was measured with)
